sources.supports: Current facility page identifies a canoe access ramp onto the Great Miami River, one mile of river frontage, daily dawn-to-dusk hours, parking, and paddling.
Identifies Heritage Park as the upstream canoe ramp on the Great Miami River and distinguishes the downstream Dravo ramp.
Lists Heritage Park river access at GM River Mile 23.8 with boat ramp, parking, picnic area, and restrooms.

sourceAssessment: Colerain Township directly establishes the public canoe ramp and operating condition; Great Miami Riverway corroborates the named access site. The site is for canoe/kayak use and not general motorized-boat use.
